purpose: Lead's INDEPENDENT measurement of the glyph-advance calibration, taken while the r5 node worked, so the node's fix can be checked against a number it did not produce.

measured.fontFamily: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans KR", ... (the SANS stack, i.e. PROPORTIONAL, which is why uppercase and digits are wider than prose)

arithmetic.withProseAdvance: 390 / 6.3813 = 61.1 chars per line -> ceil(252/61.1) = 5 lines -> 5*22.4 + 16 padding = 128px vs 126px measured
arithmetic.withAlphabetAdvance: 390 / 8.2136 = 47.5 chars per line -> ceil(252/47.5) = 6 lines -> 6*22.4 + 16 padding = 150px vs the 151px the estimator actually produced
arithmetic.conclusion: The alphabet-and-digits sample adds exactly one wrapped line to a 252-character paragraph, which is the +19.8% assistant over-estimate and therefore the C1/C2 regression.
